title: Total Loss Report
subtitle: RE: BMW 3 Series 320d M Sport — Registration CK25AEA
reLine: RE: Assessment of the above vehicle following a road traffic incident
intro: In accordance with your instructions, we have inspected the above vehicle and our findings are detailed below.
This report is provided on an independent basis. We confirm that we have no financial interest in the settlement of this claim.

blocks.text: The vehicle sustained significant impact damage to the front nearside following a collision. The damage extends to the structural members of the vehicle, as detailed in our inspection findings.

Having inspected the vehicle and assessed the extent of the damage, we consider the cost of repair to exceed the pre-accident value of the vehicle. On that basis, the vehicle is properly categorised as a total loss.

items: Structural damage to the front nearside chassis leg.
Deployment of the front and side restraint systems.
Repair cost exceeds the pre-accident value of the vehicle.

blocks.text: We consider that an equitable settlement, being the pre-accident retail value of £24,750.00 less the assessed salvage value of £2,800.00, is £21,950.00.
